purpose: Ablation arms in the six Stage 8 conditions that carried only the eight principal arms. Closes the RQ7 'PARTIAL (C2 half)' scope noted in the Stage 8 generator and promised against in manuscript S6.5.
scope_limitation: Ablations only. The eight principal arms and their SCR reference already exist in stage8_campaign for every one of these conditions and are NOT re-run; pairing is against those.
seed_policy: Held-out seeds 201+. Development seeds 101-105 are never reused.

rq_coverage.RQ7: completes the C2 half left partial by stage8_campaign

n_selection.rule: smallest n in {10,20,30} with 1.96*s_d/sqrt(n) <= 0.02 on timely_pdr
n_selection.known_shortfall: AODV-FB vs AODV-STOCK needs n=32 (s_d=0.05756); at n=30 the half-width is 0.0206 against the 0.02 target, a 3% overshoot. n=30 is the preregistered grid maximum and was kept rather than enlarged.

freshness_rule: F = max(2 s, (K-1)*M*I + 1 s), K=2, M=10, derived from ratePps and applied to every method (R022).
execution_order: condition-major (R036): finishing conditions one at a time yields fully populated cells progressively, so Section 6 can be sharpened before the campaign ends.
